A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] served as a '''sensor chief''' aboard [[Durga Besadii Tai|Durga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] [[Darksaber (superweapon)|''Darksaber'']] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]]. He was killed along with the rest of the crew when the ''Darksaber'' was destroyed in [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]] in the [[Hoth asteroid field/Legends|Hoth asteroid field]].
